## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The retry limit must be corrected before merge: the helper permits ten attempts despite the supplied project policy requiring a maximum of five.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — When an upstream repeatedly raises `OSError`, the default call makes ten attempts, exceeding the required five-attempt cap. The supplied policy states, “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” (AGENTS.md:5), and the validation also accepts values above five. Set the default and maximum to five and align the documentation and tests. — A failing upstream receives twice the permitted requests, violating the safeguard established after upstream outages.
